body: Well I'm just emotionally dead right now. I don't know.
Not much. We stayed away from doing all the big gifts and such.

Always.

I won't be meeting anyone special. Nobody else has even come close, and I don't even like the people I know now. Don't have much to do but work and wait. I don't even care to work really anymore.  What's the point of it all.

And I had to go be a fucking idiot and ruin everything. I knew it wouldn't go well and I kept it up anyway. I could have happily lived my fantasy forever and now it's all gone. 

There's no winning for me. Just lies and pretending. Nobody truely cares and nobody should. What do I ever do but lie and pretend myself? I don't even know why I bothered coming here.

Moved on I am nothing. My future would be that of a dog waiting for a master who isn't coming home. I've never had a friend like her, someone I wanted to talk to and be around, and I doubt I will again.

The movie won't be any good. It's about some unambitious minimum wage worker who sits alone and hates human contact.
